text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...It looks like it's going to rain. I 
hope the weather holds out until the Arima 
Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I came to watch the Arima Kinen 
together with Chrono Genesis.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the merch shop. M-May I... take a 
quick look inside...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The Derby and Arima Kinen have an 
especially rich selection of merch... Just 
looking at them is fun.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Seeing all the neckties and badges lined 
up really makes it feel like a race 
festival...!
choice_data_list:
Formal wear, huh. Maybe I'll buy some next 
year.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Next year...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking various factors into account, I 
decided to pass this year, but it's on the 
schedule for next year.
choice_data_list:
I'll wear it to your fan lottery next 
year.

I'll wear it to your fan lottery next 
year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Post positions for the Arima Kinen are 
determined at a public draw. Trainers are 
required to wear formal attire for it, so 
bringing along a commemorative item might 
be nice.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-Isn't it... a b-bit too early for 
that...?
choice_data_list:
If I get to join the raffle, of course I'm 
gonna get excited!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only the 'Arima Kinen' holds a public 
barrier draw. For a rookie trainer like 
me, this would be my very first time 
participating.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"It's the first time... for you too, 
Trainer...?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, I-I will definitely...! Do everything 
in my power to be able to run...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
This year's Arima Kinen really has such a 
star-studded lineup...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"There are 11 GⅠ winners here—the most in 
history. Fufu, I wonder what kind of race 
this will turn out to be...!"
choice_data_list: This really feels like a dream race, huh!
This really feels like a dream race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen in spring and the 
Arima Kinen in autumn— together they are 
known as the Grand Prix races, where the 
running Umamusume are chosen by fan votes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Depending on the voting results, dream 
showdowns become reality. And this time, 
the lineup was just as impressive.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Foremost among them was Almond Eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She conquered the Triple Tiara in her 
Classic Year, clocked a world record at 
the Japan Cup, and triumphed in an 
international GⅠ race in Dubai."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she wins the Arima Kinen, she will 
become the undisputed strongest Umamusume 
in everyone's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
All eyes are also on Lilie-san, who is 
aiming for back-to-back Grand Prix 
victories.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
After the Takarazuka Kinen, she went on to 
conquer an international GⅠ in Australia. 
She has completely awakened.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Our fellow classmate who won the Satsuki 
Sho also has a chance since Nakayama is 
her specialty...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume of Lilie-san's generation 
will surely show their grit as well.
choice_data_list:
Looks like we've got a lineup that'll make 
for a fast pace.

Looks like the field's shaping up for a 
fast pace, huh?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Since all the front-runners are drawn 
in the outside gates, there'll likely be a 
fierce battle early on... There's even a 
chance one of them might break away into a 
huge lead—
choice_data_list:
Like recreating the Arima Kinen with the 
runaway duo?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen, where Mejiro Palmer and 
Daitaku Helios broke into a massive 
runaway lead and set an astonishingly fast 
pace, is iconic beyond measure.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
That would be quite interesting! I wonder 
how Ai-san and Lilie-san would handle it.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe just like Palmer-san, a 
front-runner could actually win...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... E-Excuse me...! I-I got a bit 
carried away...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
With Trainer-san... we can have deep 
conversations about racing. Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After observing the paddock, I moved to 
the stands a bit early.
Huh? It's Chrono-san. Heyyy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hellooo! Are you here to watch too, 
Chrono-san and friends?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, what a coincidence~. If you'd like, 
there's an open seat right here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ones who called out were Special Week, 
the cheerful Umamusume raised in Hokkaido, 
and Grass Wonder, the strong-willed Yamato 
Nadeshiko.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much...! P-Pardon the 
intrusion...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Studying races even on your day off, 
you're so dedicated~."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: N-No... It's half just a hobby...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I know what you mean! The Grand Prix races 
just get you so excited, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's got that festive vibe. And best of 
all, so many fans are getting hyped up for 
it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
From an Umamusume's perspective, it just 
makes you so happy, doesn't it? âª

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hearing this immense roar of the crowd... 
reminds me of the tension during the race.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Without realizing it, my senses become 
sharpened, you could say.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, me too... Once the race starts, I just 
do it unconsciously...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-The 'Legendary Arima Kinen' between the 
two of you...! I-I could never forget that 
race either...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder and Special Week's "Legendary 
Arima Kinen"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a legendary duel decided by a mere 
four centimeters.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After a long, grueling photo finish, the 
victory goes to Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the same time, she achieved a 
three-peat victory in the Grand Prix.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A-As a fan, getting to see this dream 
showdown... I'm from the bottom of my 
heart grateful to you both for running...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, hearing you say that makes me 
really glad I ran!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Well, but back then... I lost, and it was 
sooooo frustrating!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Spe-chan, if it's a rematch you 
want, I'm ready to take you on anytime~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the gates of the Arima Kinen burst 
open. The frontrunner pulls away from the 
pack, setting a blistering pace.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama has a short home stretch. If they 
pull any further ahead, it's going to be 
tough.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —I'm making my move right here!

text_block_list.name: Schön Lilie
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-san made her move! Not yet, though. 
I'll... bet everything on the final 
stretch!"

text_block_list.name: Schön Lilie
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Schön Lilie
text_block_list.text:
It's not Ai-san... First place goes 
to—ME!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
SchÃ¶n Lilie breaks away! She pulls ahead! 
SchÃ¶n Lilie crosses the line in first 
place!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Schön Lilie becomes the first Tiara 
Umamusume to achieve back-to-back Grand 
Prix victories!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Lilie-san...!
choice_data_list: That was such a dominant win!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, with 200 meters left, on an uphill no 
less, that closing kick...! It was utterly 
dominant!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
A 5-length lead!? She's way too strong! 
Tiara Umamusume these days are insane!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Lilie-chan, to think a day like this would 
come...! Back when you couldn't win, I 
never even dreamed of this! I'm so happy 
for you... so happy!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Even if you start slower than others, hard 
work will eventually blossom. ...You've 
given me courage. Thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...The Grand Prix really is wonderful 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume whom they cheered on and 
entrusted their dreams to... will answer 
those feelings...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Even without a stellar track record... the 
fan vote might just give her a shot at the 
GⅠ stage...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Before entering Tracen Academy... I, too, 
cast my fan votes with special feelings in 
my heart...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
When you run... and give it everything 
you've got, I feel like you're answering 
my feelings...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In fact, we were running with that exact 
intention as well.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I have always been supported by everyone's 
cheers. I ran with heartfelt gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, crying and laughing together with 
all our fans... It really is a special 
race.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Coming to the Arima Kinen always reminds 
me of that incredible sense of unity!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So even with the frustration, I still end 
up wanting to come every year.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
For the fans and for the Umamusume alike, 
the Grand Prix is a truly special race, 
isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. About our goals for the Senior 
Class...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Out of the classic routes, I want to 
master the Grand Prix races―― the 
Takarazuka Kinen and the Arima Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Just like Gran-chan and the mile... I'll 
make the Grand Prix the race where I won't 
lose, the race that becomes synonymous 
with me...!
choice_data_list: Why did you choose the Grand Prix?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I have a general idea, but I'd like to 
hear it from you to make sure we're on the 
same page.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Watching all the fans cheering for 
Lilie-san... made me think.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I want to run in races that can move fans' 
hearts like that, too...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Through that drama, I want to etch my 
hoofprints into history...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Prix is... a symbol of Japanese 
racing history, supported by the fans 
throughout the years.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Because I am a fan of racing myself...! I 
thought that perhaps I could be the one to 
demonstrate its significance...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
In addition... due to the course layouts 
and the torn-up turf at the end of the 
meet, both the Takarazuka Kinen and Arima 
Kinen can be called particularly grueling 
races...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Until now, Umamusume who came through the 
Tiara route were said to have a hard time 
winning... but Lilie has shattered that 
perception."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"If I follow with consecutive victories as 
well, wouldn't that elevate the reputation 
of Tiara Umamusume even further...?!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
And once Gran-chan, Loves-chan, and 
Bouquet-san each reach the pinnacle of 
their own paths—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Our generation... can become the 
'Strongest Tiara Generation'...!"
choice_data_list:
So you can build a generation that only 
you could create—huh!

You can build a generation that only you 
can create—!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes...!
choice_data_list:
For senior year, let's aim for 
back-to-back Grand Prix wins!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much... ...First up is the 
Osaka Hai, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'll deliver solid results... and secure 
my entry into the Takarazuka Kinen...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To master the royal road, and leave an 
unparalleled hoofprint in history 
alongside everyone of our generation."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The path Chrono Genesis walks is the royal 
road to back-to-back Grand Prix 
victories—!
